title: Zesty Juicy Slovakian Broccoli Dumplings
description: A traditional Slovakian dish featuring broccoli and mustard, deep-fried to perfection, this recipe is halal-friendly and perfect for midnight cravings. The combination of juicy broccoli and zesty mustard creates a unique flavor experience.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the chopped broccoli, flour, egg, mustard, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Gradually add the water to the bowl and mix until a thick dough forms.
Knead the dough for about 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into small balls, about the size of a small egg.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Carefully add the dough balls to the hot oil and deep-fry until they are golden brown.
Remove the dumplings from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the Zesty Juicy Slovakian Broccoli Dumplings hot and enjoy.
